Job Title EI Solution Architect and Team Leader Job Description EI Solutions Architect and Team Leader, Enterprise Informatics Based out of: Australia Job Family Summary: The Solutions Architect Team Leader will lead the centralized solution architect team focusing on Philips ' Enterprise Informatics (EI) Portfolio, that includes cardiology, radiology and pathology information systems.

Philips ' Enterprise Informatics portfolio and the integration layers that connect them into a customer's broader clinical and IT environment, are technically deep, clinically regulated, and often mission-critical to hospital operations.

This role leads the team responsible for architecting that portfolio into real customer environments, from presales through to handover.

The successful candidate will carry their own architecture caseload alongside the rest of the team, including the most complex or strategically important opportunities while also building the capability, standards, and judgement of the wider team.

Hands-on design work and people leadership are both core parts of this role This person will report directly to EI Business Operations Leader who is based in Perth.

You are responsible for: Participates in customer requirements analysis, actively analyzes client needs to inform the development of solutions aligned with customer expectations and business objectives, and conducts thorough assessments of existing infrastructure to recommend appropriate, scalable, reliable, and secure solutions architecture.

While actively contributing to Solution Architect responsibilities, you will also lead the team in goal setting, performance management, talent development, process standardization, and fostering team cohesion, adhering to Philips ' leadership principles.

Contributes to solution architecture efforts, collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop innovative solutions that meet project requirements and align with organizational objectives and industry best practices, working under limited supervision.

Creates standardized architecture templates, ensures consistency and clarity in pre-sales documentation, and facilitates efficient communication of scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines to stakeholders.

Identifies and proposes solutions for routine issues, leverages expertise and collaboration with senior leaders to ensure effective problem resolution, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement and proactive problem-solving within the organization.

Stays current on product, solutions, services, IT, and industry trends, offers clients best-in-class solutions, ethically monitors competitor product offerings, and actively engages as a member of the Community of Practice for solution architecture.

Conducts comprehensive surveys of the competitive healthcare market landscape to gather insights into data-driven solutions, trends, and potential architectural use cases.

Develops tailored solutions by collaborating with domain experts that align with customer requirements and budgetary constraints, ensuring the delivery of tailored and cost-effective solutions that meet client expectations and drive business value.

To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience: Minimum 4 years’ experience in Solution or Technical Architecture, preferably with Healthcare experience in Radiology, Cardiology or Pathology, or other clinical systems.

Bachelors Degree in Healthcare or IT Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining strong external (and internal) relationships with stakeholders, including Senior Management Experience in comprehensive technical blueprints encompassing hardware and software Working knowledge of the IT infrastructure that Healthcare Informatics solutions run on, including server / storage architecture, virtualisation, networking, and security / compliance requirements for clinical systems.

Strong leadership acumen and high-level communicator Excellent organizational skills, written and oral presentation skills with the ability to present to any audience, including Clinical, Technical and Executive-level stakeholders.

Driven to continually learn and improve with a ‘can do’ approach An enthusiastic, high-energy approach to the delivery of first-class Solutions for our Customers – fostering positive customer relations and satisfaction. About Philips We are a health technology company.

We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

Our platform powers billions of mission critical workflows across industries like fintech, e-commerce, logistics, and healthcare helping companies run the core operations of their business with confidence. An applied research team within NVIDIA ’s Networking Systems & Software Architecture group is solving some of AI’s hardest infrastructure problems.

The team builds systems-level software that moves data between GPUs, nodes, and storage at the speed modern AI demands—spanning low-level transport optimization, hardware-software co-design, and communication frameworks that plug directly into production AI stacks.

The team's charter expands into emerging domains including quantum computing interconnects. The Senior Architect role is to own modules and projects end-to-end—from scoping research questions to shipping production code.

It calls for a recognized expert who drives technical decisions, pulls in ideas from research and industry, and regularly prototypes new approaches to prove a point. The work lives at the boundary of applied research and production engineering! What you will be doing:
Architecting and implementing high-performance communication and memory management libraries for distributed AI
Driving hardware-software co-optimization with GPU, DPU, NIC, and switch teams through GPUDirect RDMA, NVLink, and next-generation interconnects
Profiling and optimizing data movement across GPU memory, system DRAM, NVMe, and network fabrics
